card.name: Patient willingness and commitment to requirements
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about a person being willing, able or required to commit to a duty, such as caring for a pet, following monitoring, or agreeing to a schedule. It fires on the word right after the willingness cue, or on the closing words of that duty.

modes.label: Willingness to comply
modes.description: Words after phrases like unwilling to, agree to, or must acknowledge, where a patient or caregiver takes on an obligation.
modes.example: healthcare providers should carefully select patients who agree to<< the>> required every 6 month injection dosing

modes.label: Ability to adhere
modes.description: Words in lists of what a patient must be able to understand, adhere to, or have monitored.
modes.example: SYMLIN should be used only in patients who can fully understand and adhere to proper insulin adjustments<< and>> glucose monitoring.

modes.label: Expectations and commitment
modes.description: Nouns or verbs about commitment or expectations in candidate or program requirements.
modes.example: Females must<< commit>> either to abstain continuously from heterosexual sexual

card.writes: It pushes toward words about commitment, promises and obligations.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text says a patient must be willing and able to follow requirements.
